summary: Iteration 13 — Iter11 Explainability + Action Layer verification: FULL PASS across all requested areas. (1) Dedicated iter11 in-process suite: 39/39 PASS in 0.85s (`tests/test_iter11_explainability_and_action_center.py`, TestA_Rules×10 + TestB_TextComposition×7 + TestC_ExplanationAPI×6 + TestD_StateMachine×10 + TestE_History×2 + TestF_NoRegression×4). (2) Combined regression iter8+9+10+11 in single pytest session: 131/131 PASS in 14.38s, zero motor 'Event loop is closed' errors, zero flakes. (3) NEW live smoke suite `tests/test_iter11_live_smoke.py` (13 tests) hitting https://ora-decision-engine.preview.emergentagent.com with demo@ora.app: 13/13 PASS in 4.88s — TestLiveExplanation×5 (envelope has all 13 required keys incl. version='explainability/v1.0'; data_sources[*].source ∈ whitelist {Google Calendar, Life Graph, Knowledge Layer, Daily Intelligence, Manual Input}; body contains ZERO leak tokens {ExplanationService, AppliedRule, Traceback, /app/backend, openai, gpt-, LlmChat, emergentintegrations}; human_summary has NO Python class-name pattern [A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z]; freshly-created decision explanation includes 'Manual Input' source) + TestLiveActionCenter×5 (start→partial→complete history returns exactly 3 rows in order start/partial/complete on field `user_action` with immutable=true on every row; double-complete → 409 detail.error='invalid_transition'; POST /postpone with empty body → 422, with until_datetime → 200 and postponed_until echoed inside action_state; POST /blocked missing reason → 422, with reason → 200 and reason echoed; POST /dismiss accepts empty body AND {reason:...} both → 200 backward-compat verified) + TestLiveIsolation×1 (fresh ephemeral user gets 404 on user A's /explanation AND /history — not 403, prevents enumeration) + TestLiveInvariants×2 (GET /api/decisions/top?limit=3 → 200 with 'items' key still working; permission_audit endpoint not accessible from demo but confirmed grep-clean in module). (4) Zero-leak filesystem grep: `grep -rE 'openai|emergentintegrations|LlmChat|gpt-' /app/backend/explainability /app/backend/action_center` → 0 matches (exit 1). (5) Feature flag OFF (§4) covered by in-process tests test_c4_flag_off_returns_404 and test_d10_flag_off_disables_new_endpoints — both PASS; live preview has flags ON by default so cannot be toggled remotely. (6) State machine matrix (§8) covered end-to-end by TestD_StateMachine×10 (all transitions incl. pending→{in_progress,partially_completed,completed,postponed,dismissed,blocked}, in_progress→{partial,complete,postpone,blocked,dismiss}, postponed→{in_progress,dismissed,blocked}, blocked→{in_progress,postponed,dismissed}, completed & dismissed terminal). GRAND TOTAL: 39 + 131 + 13 = 183 assertions across 3 pytest runs, 100% green. No product bugs, no leaks, no side-effects on ranking/decision_engine/OAuth/GoogleCal/ingestion/life_graph/knowledge/daily_intel/security. Iter11 is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: explainability/rules.py, text.py, service.py, types.py: pure deterministic layer, ZERO imports of openai/emergentintegrations/LlmChat/gpt-* (filesystem grep confirmed). Rule detectors emit AppliedRule records that are internal-only; the /explanation response body strips class names — human_summary is composed from Italian templates only and passes the regex [A-Z][a-z]+[A-Z] purity check both in unit tests (test_b3) and live (test_d_human_summary_no_class_names).

action_center/state_machine.py: 7 statuses (pending, in_progress, partially_completed, postponed, blocked, completed, dismissed) with an explicit transition matrix. `completed` and `dismissed` are terminal (empty outgoing set) → double-complete returns 409 with detail.error='invalid_transition' both in-process (test_d4/test_d8) and live (test_b_complete_on_completed_is_409).

action_center/history.py: append-only DecisionActionHistory, one row per successful transition, immutable=true on every row. Ordering preserved via ISO timestamps. History is per-decision AND per-user (test_e2 + live test_cross_user_returns_404 → 404 on cross-user history read).

routers/decisions.py: 6 new POST endpoints (start/partial/postpone/blocked, extended dismiss/complete) + 2 GET (history, explanation). Pydantic body models enforce required fields: /postpone.until_datetime and /blocked.reason both return 422 when missing (verified live). /dismiss and /complete remain backward-compatible with empty body (verified live). Feature-flag guards return 404 (not 403) when disabled — correct choice, prevents endpoint enumeration.

Cross-user isolation returns 404 (not 403) on /explanation and /history for another user's decision id — matches spec §7 anti-enumeration requirement. Verified live with a freshly-registered ephemeral user.

Zero side-effects verified live: test_f2_action_center_never_creates_new_decisions in-process + live test flow (start→partial→complete + postpone + blocked + dismiss on separate seeded decisions) does not touch /api/decisions/top ordering (test_f3) and /latest context still returns strict 4-key envelope (test_f4). data_sources whitelist enforced server-side: any value outside {Google Calendar, Life Graph, Knowledge Layer, Daily Intelligence, Manual Input} would fail live test_b_data_sources_whitelist_only.

No file under /app/frontend/, /app/backend/decision_engine/, /app/backend/connectors/, /app/backend/life_graph/, /app/backend/knowledge_layer/, /app/backend/daily_intelligence/ was modified by Iter11 — module is purely additive (explainability/ + action_center/ + router extensions on decisions.py).

success_rate.backend: 100% (183/183 across iter11 in-process + iter8+9+10+11 combined regression + iter11 live smoke)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter11 Explainability + Action Layer is production-ready. Reproduce: (a) `cd /app/backend && CALENDAR_PROVIDER_MODE=fake python -m pytest tests/test_iter11_explainability_and_action_center.py -n 0 -v` → 39/39 in ~0.9s. (b) Combined regression: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL="https://ora-decision-engine.preview.emergentagent.com" CALENDAR_PROVIDER_MODE=fake python -m pytest tests/test_iter8_permissions_connectors.py tests/test_iter9_ingestion_and_google_calendar.py tests/test_iter10_daily_intelligence.py tests/test_iter11_explainability_and_action_center.py -n 0` → 131/131 in ~14s. (c) Live smoke: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter11_live_smoke.py -n 0 -v` → 13/13 in ~5s (requires preview URL up + demo credentials valid). Key implementation detail for future testing: history row field for the transition verb is `user_action` (values: start/partial/complete/postpone/block/dismiss), status fields are `old_status`/`new_status`, and login response returns `token` (not `access_token`) — accepted both in the smoke helper.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects. All 8 spec sections (1→8) verified. Only tweak needed was a test helper: aligning to actual login response key (`token`) and history row schema (`user_action`) — no product changes.
